% Converted, ltx-talk. C-TITLEPAGE workaround: do not call \maketitle at all --
% lay the title frame out by hand so the attribution slot has somewhere to go.
% assets/preamble-template.tex packages this as \coursetitlepage{title}{subtitle}
% {attribution}; this fixture inlines a minimal equivalent so it stands alone.
%
% Keep \title/\author/\institute regardless: they still feed the footer and the
% PDF metadata even when \maketitle is never called.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard=a-4, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\title{Constraint Satisfaction}
\author{A. Lecturer}
\institute{University of Somewhere}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]
\begin{center}
{\Large Constraint Satisfaction}

\medskip
A. Lecturer

{\footnotesize University of Somewhere}
\end{center}
\vfill
{\footnotesize Material adapted from Russell \& Norvig.}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
